what_it_is: The sensor's ID code. Unique per device.
Readable sensor name: neighborhood + unit number, e.g. 'Rogers Park 2'.
Start of the hour, in UTC. This is the column weather and traffic were joined on.
watch_out_for: Don't use it for hour-of-day questions — it's 5-6 hours off local time.

what_it_is: The same moment in Chicago time. Use this for anything about time of day or the work week.
watch_out_for: DST days have 23 or 25 local hours.

what_it_is: Sensor latitude.
watch_out_for: Never changes for a given sensor.

what_it_is: Sensor longitude.
watch_out_for: Never changes for a given sensor.

what_it_is: Nitrogen dioxide for this hour. The main traffic-related pollutant.
watch_out_for: Comes from a calibration model, not a raw reading. Identical sensors side by side disagree by 1.6-3.8 ppb, so that's the noise floor.

what_it_is: Fine particle pollution (smoke, dust, soot) for this hour.
watch_out_for: Huge right tail: max 487. Use log_pm25 instead for most work.

what_it_is: log(1 + pm25). The version to actually model.
Official EPA air quality index for NO2.
watch_out_for: Never went above 100 in 14 months. Almost constant — little use as an outcome.

what_it_is: Official EPA air quality index for PM2.5 (NowCast method).
watch_out_for: Above 100 in under 1% of hours, nearly all in 3 episodes. Too rare to predict.

what_it_is: NO2 at this sensor one hour ago. The single best predictor of NO2 now.
watch_out_for: Only valid where hours_since_obs == 0.

what_it_is: NO2 at this sensor at the same hour yesterday. Captures the daily rhythm.
watch_out_for: Only valid where hours_since_obs == 0.

what_it_is: log PM2.5 one hour ago. Even more persistent than NO2.
watch_out_for: Only valid where hours_since_obs == 0.

what_it_is: log PM2.5 at the same hour yesterday.
watch_out_for: Only valid where hours_since_obs == 0.

what_it_is: Hour of day in Chicago time. 0 = midnight.
watch_out_for: Already acts as a stand-in for traffic — any traffic variable has to beat it.

what_it_is: Day of week. 0 = Monday, 6 = Sunday.
watch_out_for: Weekend = dow >= 5, if you want that as its own flag.

what_it_is: Calendar month. Stands in for season and whether trees have leaves.
US federal holiday, by local date.
watch_out_for: July 4 2026 falls on a Saturday, so July 3 is the observed holiday. Both are flagged.

what_it_is: Median NO2 across all sensors reporting this hour. Explains ~58% of NO2 variation.
watch_out_for: SAME hour, so it already contains the answer. Fine for EDA, cheating in a forecast.

what_it_is: Median log PM2.5 across all sensors this hour. Explains ~84% of PM2.5 variation.
watch_out_for: Same warning as no2_city.

what_it_is: How many sensors reported this hour. Doubles as a network-health check.
watch_out_for: Drops from 283 to 165 during the outage, 28 Jul - 13 Aug 2026.

what_it_is: Air temperature at O'Hare airport.
watch_out_for: Same value for every sensor in an hour.

what_it_is: Relative humidity at O'Hare.
watch_out_for: Also affects the sensors themselves — low-cost PM sensors read high in humid air.

what_it_is: Wind speed. The main thing that disperses pollution.
watch_out_for: Low wind (under ~2 m/s) is when pollution builds up.

what_it_is: Direction the wind is coming FROM. 0 = north, 90 = east.
watch_out_for: DO NOT put this in a model. 359 and 1 are neighbours but look 358 apart. Use wind_u.

what_it_is: East-west wind component. Positive = blowing toward the east.
watch_out_for: This is the model-safe version of wind direction.

what_it_is: Rain in the past hour. Washes particles out of the air.
Which of Chicago's 29 traffic regions the sensor sits in.
watch_out_for: Regions are rectangles, so a few sensors land in the wrong one (e.g. Brighton Park -> 'Lawndale').

what_it_is: Average vehicle speed in that region this hour. LOW speed = congestion.
watch_out_for: EMPTY after 30 Apr 2026 — the city stopped publishing. Only ~62% of rows have it.

what_it_is: Tree cover, from 2023 aerial imagery.
watch_out_for: Covers the whole census tract, not the block around the sensor.

what_it_is: Paved and built-over surface: roads, roofs, parking.
watch_out_for: Strongly opposite to canopy_pct — they'll fight each other in a model.

what_it_is: Straight-line distance to the Loop (State & Madison).
watch_out_for: Tangled up with canopy, pavement and roads — downtown has less of everything green.

what_it_is: Metres of expressway within 500 m of the sensor.
watch_out_for: Zero for most sensors — only some sit near an expressway.

what_it_is: Area zoned for manufacturing within 500 m.
watch_out_for: This is zoning permission, not measured emissions. A zoned lot may be empty.

what_it_is: How many hours since this sensor last had a real reading. 0 = this hour has one.
watch_out_for: THE GUARD COLUMN. Filter to 0 for anything using lags, or stale values look real.
